text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The challenge at the award ceremony attracted a lot of attention, driving flocks of fans to the Hanshin Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian, however, is the same as ever. She pays no mind to the crowd, instead bringing her competitiveness up to a boil.
